column1: # analysis/naming2/wramx_consumers.tsv -- consumer rules of tools/apply_ram_operands.py --areas wramx (docs/research/naming2_ramop7.md)
# A raw pointer operand `ld hl|de|bc, $Dxxx` is banked WRAM: the same address is another variable in every bank.  It is written as the name of ram/banked.asm for the bank of the rule when

# the routine that receives the register (the first call/farcall/tail jp of the straight line, only plain instructions touching neither the register nor the bank in between) dereferences it in that bank.
# needs: `-` the routine selects the bank itself; `switch` the caller does, and the tool must find the bank idiom (`ld a, $0N / ldh [hWRAMBank], a / ldh [rSVBK], a`, or a call that sets the bank:
# analysis/naming2/wramx_calls.tsv) of that bank earlier in the same straight line; `a` the routine takes the bank of the pointer in A (0 = the bank in force): the constant in A at the call must be
# the bank, or 0 with the idiom showing the bank.  family: a regular expression the chosen name must match (a rule is about one kind of object).
# The name states the bank in which the consumer dereferences the pointer; the caller's own bank may be another one.
